purpose: Prove the minimum Durable Execution core without chat-dependent state before any trigger/system integration.

protocol: initialize durable portfolio generation 0
admit one exact ResumeTickObservation
commit exactly one generation
destroy the initiating store/session object
construct a fresh SqlitePortfolioHeadStore from the same database path
recover portfolio + checkpoint using recover_portfolio_after_restart
prove exact state/checkpoint digests without chat context
start with Active VERIFYING, Secondary READY, at least two Passive entries
admit explicit wake evidence for one Passive
apply verification_passed with verifier_pass evidence
prove old Secondary becomes Active READY
prove only the admitted Passive becomes Secondary READY
prove completed Active is not silently re-enqueued
prove no external Secondary selection was accepted
start with Active WAITING_EXTERNAL carrying blocker + wake condition
admit a current Passive wake
supply external_blocker + no_internal_work evidence
prove blocked Active becomes Passive with wake condition preserved
prove old Secondary becomes Active
prove admitted Passive becomes Secondary
prove network timeout retries stop at configured ceiling
prove provider throttling backoff is bounded
prove deterministic assertion never retries
prove unknown failure permits exactly one independent reproduction
prove cost boundary stops without hidden spend authority
prove security/authority boundary reaches human gate
race two identical observations against the same durable head
prove only one generation is committed
prove the loser returns already_applied when the same observation is recovered
submit a different stale observation
prove it returns stale_observation and does not mutate the head
drive Active to human_gate using authority_required evidence
prove checkpoint authority_stop=true and next_transition_refs empty
invoke a new tick with no observation
prove requested_action_ref is the human authority action
prove human_required=true
prove no authority_ref is fabricated

promotion_rule: CORE-1 may be PASS only when a valid CoreVerificationReceipt opens the gate and all required assertions carry durable evidence. The rehearsal itself does not enable unattended runtime.
